title: DIS Study Playground
description: An interactive companion for the Data Intensive Systems course: visual explanations, playgrounds and quizzes, one lecture at a time.
overviewTitle: An interactive playground for the concepts behind data-intensive systems.
overviewMd: Each lecture is a guided path: the intuition first, then the technical detail, with playgrounds where moving a slider is faster than reading a paragraph. Progress and quiz scores are kept in your browser.
footerText: A personal, interactive companion for the Data Intensive Systems course. Content is built from the course material and the assigned book chapters; progress is stored locally in your browser.
